algorithm: time-dependent elliptical spread on the Mangum 90 m field (slope-plane, hourly HRRR): graph = label-setting on a radius-8 stencil; levelset = WENO5/LLF/TVD-RK3 narrow band; hybrid (HY, D1) = level set then graph seeded with its arrivals
input: mangum 90 m model field, hand-set parameters, windows centred on the first perimeter, 24 h from it

hardware.threads: single-threaded kernels; scenario rows use a thread pool (ensemble.run_many)

harness: timeit.repeat(number=1); reference repeat=1, Rust repeat=3; scenario rows repeat=3
